blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebuanos seeking National ID services at the 24/7 Government Services Hub here should bring the appropriate supporting documents, particularly those applying for registration or requesting changes to their personal information. The Philippine Statistics Authority (PSA) Cebu Provincial Statistical Office will provide round-the-clock National ID services at the hub from Sept. 21 to 26, 2026, giving applicants access to registration, updating of demographic information, and other National ID concerns at any hour.
